briefdescription.para: Create a ReplicaValidationHandler wired to a ShardRepairEngine.

detaileddescription.para: This free function is the canonical startup wiring that resolves the roadmap item "Replica consistency check integration with sharding/replication module (v1.2.0)" without introducing a compile-time dependency on the sharding module from the maintenance module itself.

parameterdescription.para: Shared pointer to a live ShardRepairEngine. Must not be null.

simplesect.para: A ReplicaValidationHandler that delegates to engine->runConsistencyCheck().
